description: This source file implements the BufferParser class and its derived classes for parsing media buffers, extracting media segment data, and handling protection metadata, codec data, and specific media formats (audio/video).

classes.name: BufferParser
classes.description: Base class for parsing media buffers, providing methods to parse buffer data, add codec data, and add protection metadata.

classes.name: AudioBufferParser
classes.description: Derived class for parsing audio-specific buffer data, extracting sample rate and channel count.

classes.name: VideoBufferParser
classes.description: Derived class for parsing video-specific buffer data, extracting width, height, and framerate.

methods.name: parseBuffer
methods.description: Main method to parse a media buffer sample, extract timestamp, duration, and media structure, and produce a MediaSegment object.

methods.name: addProtectionMetadataToSegment
methods.description: Adds encryption and protection metadata to a media segment based on buffer and structure information.

methods.name: addCodecDataToSegment
methods.description: Extracts codec data from the structure and attaches it to the media segment.

methods.name: parseSpecificPartOfBuffer (Audio)
methods.description: Parses audio-specific information such as sample rate and channels from the structure.

methods.name: parseSpecificPartOfBuffer (Video)
methods.description: Parses video-specific information such as width, height, and framerate from the structure.
